Subject: Quick demo — product fit for data pipeline?

Hi Grace,

I signed up for a trial this morning and had a quick look — Opterra Labs is evaluating a few inference serving vendors for a pilot (low-latency document parsing + embeddings). Would love a short walkthrough to confirm fit. I’m based in Boston (EST), availability today between 10–3pm, or tomorrow morning works too.

I’m looping Sarah (ops) on schedules. Can you point me to a quick slot or the shortest possible demo you offer?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Dunne
Engineering Manager, Opterra Labs
alex.dunne@opterra.com
+1 617-555-0148

Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 10:05:22 -0400

Hi Alex — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for signing up and for the context. I can do a 30-minute walkthrough today at 2:00pm ET or tomorrow 9:00am ET. If you only have a short window, we also offer a focused 15-minute "quick-fit" that covers latency/cost profile and a one-page rollout checklist.

I’ve tentatively added 2:00pm to my calendar — here’s the booking link if you prefer a different time: https://cal.redwood.ai/j/GRACE-152345

Agenda (attached): 1) 10-min product tour 2) 10-min fit discussion 3) next steps & trial checkpoints.

Attachments: opterra-demo-agenda.pdf

If 2pm works, reply "Confirm" and I’ll send the invite.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 13:05:11 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick demo — preferred time?

Hi Alex — I noticed you weren’t on the 2:00pm call; no worries. I recorded the short walkthrough and dropped it here: https://drive.redwood.ai/file/d/1a2b3c-opterra-onboarding (2:40 video).

If you’d still like to reconnect live, quick options that work for our team tomorrow: 9:00–9:30am ET, 11:00–11:30am ET, or a 15-minute slot at 2:15pm ET. Alternatively, we can do an async 15-minute review where I send a focused prompt set and sample results from your sample dataset.

To save time, I attached the one-page agenda and a short 15-min invite you can accept directly. If you prefer, reply with the single time that works best and I’ll lock it.

Attachments: redwood-15min-officehours.ics, opterra-demo-agenda.pdf

Thanks — happy to make this as frictionless as possible.

Best,
Grace

Subject: Quick follow — 90s product tour if helpful

Alex — Priyom here from the SDR team. Grace shared the recording above; if you want a <90s highlight reel I can fire over a one-slide summary and the three metrics you’ll care about (latency, cost/token, expected throughput) using your sample size.

No need to book — reply and I’ll send the short summary + a single best-guess config for a small pilot.

Cheers,

Subject: Quick 15-min office hours tomorrow?

Alex — I’m Tessa (AE) and I’ll be picking this up from Grace. If a live sync still makes sense, I can host a focused 15-minute slot tomorrow at 11:00am ET to run the two quick checks: 1) expected latency on your sample payload 2) integration checklist for trial. If that time doesn’t work, I can do 3:30pm ET or we can do an async Loom I’ll record specifically for Opterra (5–7 minutes).

Propose one of the options below and I’ll send a calendar invite immediately:
- Tomorrow 11:00–11:15am ET (live)
- Tomorrow 15:30–15:45pm ET (live)
- Async Loom + config notes (I’ll send within 24 hours)

If you’d rather, accept the 15-min invite Grace attached and I’ll adjust to whatever fits. Appreciate the time — we want to make it easy to evaluate without a big calendar commitment.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
